               Dear Dr Edwards
               Re: Ms Sara Day       DOB: 29/07/1997

               I am writing to refer Ms Day, whose features are consistent with neurological manifestations including headache, anxiety and
               depression. Your further assessment and investigation would be valued.

               On 06/12/2017, Ms Day presented at my clinic with her mother with 2-week- history of unilateral sever steady rapid onset headache
               originated from the temporal region extended to the vertex, associated with loss of balance , nausea and visual disturbance.
               However, symptoms not affected by triggers like chocolate and alcohol. She educated on rest, relaxation along with adequate sleep.
               Metoclopramide and paracetamol was prescribed.

               On 04/01/2018, Ms Day came to me with the complaint of neck pain and one occasion of vomiting. In addition the prescribed
               medication previously was ineffective and the attacks becomes more frequent. Based on that, the anxiety becomes more worse.
               She advised on eletriptan and ibuprofen.

               On todays visit, Ms Day attended my clinic alone with the complaints of numbness and tingling sensation in the fourth and fifth
               fingers of the left hand. She has had a history of a car accident in jun 2017, which leading to sustained whiplash injury. Therefore,
               her wishes to keep this issues away from her mother.

               In view of above, your further evaluation and treatment would be greatly appreciated.

               Yours sincerely
               Doctor
